dialogues.speaker: Nameless Tablet (VI)
dialogues.text: "I thought Ormazd would bring about a new order and purge this tiny desert world of slavery... yet he failed me."

dialogues.speaker: Nameless Tablet (VI)
dialogues.text: "And so I punished him, destroying his kingdom utterly, and passing ruin from father unto son, unto the third generation."

dialogues.speaker: Nameless Tablet (VI)
dialogues.text: "...Slavery dressed up as 'happiness' is worse than a brutal death..."
